text:
```yaml
name: Docker Smoke Test

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v2.9.0'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Build project
      run: npm run build

    - name: Run smoke tests
      run: npm test -- --smoke
```
